programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: In this high-stakes Bronze Medal match at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships, veteran competitors Jenny Klitch and Sheri Courter go head-to-head with Ellen Novoseletsky and Jenny Marcos. Expect calculated teamwork, steady hands, and sharp strategy as these seasoned senior pros compete for a podium finish. Filmed live from Naples, Florida, this match showcases the competitive spirit and skill that define senior pro pickleball.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League Season 2 continues its high-energy opening day at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai with a star-studded clash between Delhi Dilwale and the Chennai Super Champs. Watch as international stars like Delhi’s Max "Purple Jesus" Manthao and Chennai’s Hwang Nam Lee—a former Wimbledon junior doubles champion—bring world-class precision to the court. With celebrity co-owner Samantha cheering from the sidelines and strategic masterclasses from coach Wesley Gabrielsson, this tie features a gauntlet of intense Women’s Singles, Men's Singles, and high-speed Doubles matches. Experience every "Ernie" shot, tactical "pickle play," and the longest video challenge in league history as these two powerhouse teams battle for early-season dominance.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The 2024 DUPR Collegiate Virginia Beach Super Regional concludes with a heavy-hitting championship showdown between two of the nation's premier pickleball programs: the University of Virginia and the University of North Carolina. The match features elite talent, including former national champion Alexandra McDonald for UVA and standout players like Ian Hutter and Sarah Carpenter for the Tar Heels.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: November 21, 2023 - Welcome to week 9 - season 2 of The Arizona Pickleball League! It's Tuesday Night Pickleball @ The Orchard, and the Tempe Tornadoes face-off against the Peoria Pythons.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: In this gripping quarterfinal from the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships, Helen Wilhelm and Anna Shirley face Suzanne LeBlang and Teresa Tarn in a thrilling three-game battle. Featuring powerful strokes, smart resets, and tactical momentum shifts, this senior pro women’s doubles match highlights both experience and finesse. Watch as the teams adapt and clash in a showcase of skill and strategy at the highest level.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The 2025–26 season reaches its epic conclusion as the defending champion Utah Tech Trailblazers face a "mountain to climb" against the undefeated Florida Atlantic Owls. With FAU yet to drop a game all weekend and Utah Tech’s Lauren Mercado battling through a knee injury, the stakes couldn't be higher at Life Time Peachtree Corners. Witness elite precision and "revolutionary" play in this final showdown for the national title.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Indianapolis Drivers take on the Coachella Valley Scorpions in a women's NPL team match.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: October 11, 2022 - Live from The Orchard @ Jigsaw Health, it's Tuesday Night Pickleball

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Bengaluru Jawans go head-to-head with the Rajasthan Titans at the iconic Jio World Garden in Mumbai. The stakes are higher than ever in this Day 9, Tie 16 clash, featuring elite matchups such as the "women's singles player of the season" Katrina Stewart facing off against the resilient Lorena Dupnik. Watch as tactical masters like Dusty Boyer and Jack Foster battle for supremacy in a series of intense singles and mixed doubles competitions where every point counts toward the league standings. With game-changing "Pickle Plays" and atmospheric "drums" fueling the intensity, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit and strategic precision.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: Former national champions collide in a high-stakes semifinal as the North Carolina Tar Heels take on the Utah Tech Trailblazers. With the historic opportunity to become the first program to reach three finals and potentially the first-ever two-time national champion, these "familiar foes" bring elite athleticism and championship pedigree to the court. Experience the intensity at Lifetime Peachtree Corners as raw power meets tactical precision in a pulse-pounding battle for a spot in the national championship match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Christine Karges and David Weinbach take on Lee Whitwell and Jaime Oncins in this Mixed Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Jaime Oncins and Simone Jardim take on Lee Whitwell and Andrei Daescu in this Mixed Pro Split Age Gold Medal Match.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Naples JBB United face off against the Boca Raton Picklers in a Women's match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Anna Leigh Waters and J.W. Johnson take on Megan Fudge and Andrei Daescu in this Mixed Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Lee Whitwell and Andrei Daescu take on Patrick Cote and Susannah Barr in this Mixed Pro Split Age Quarterfinal.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Senior Pro Singles Gold Medal match between Paul Olin and Rick Witsken.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The undefeated Florida Atlantic University Owls face off against the underdog University of Miami Hurricanes in this intense collegiate showdown. Watch as these talented athletes leave it all on the court across thrilling Women's Doubles, Men's Doubles, and Mixed Doubles matchups. Both squads must push their limits for a highly coveted spot in the regional finals. Will Miami's aggressive energy be enough to disrupt the dominant rhythm of the heavily favored FAU team?

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Indianapolis Drivers take on the Princeton Bruisers in a mixed team match.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: Witness a high-stakes semifinal showdown at the 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championships as the Texas Longhorns take on the Grand Canyon University Antelopes. Despite predictive analytics giving them a 0% win probability, the GCU "Antelopes" display elite "Skills" early on, jumping to a dominant 11-1 lead against the professional-level talent of the Longhorns. The "Racing" tempo of the match is fueled by a relentless GCU crowd that puts immense pressure on Texas stars like Zoya Khan and Natalie Loo. With the defending champions already sidelined, both teams showcase "Freestyle" grit and creativity in a battle to crown a brand-new national champion.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2023
programme.desc: In this charity showdown, Pro pickleball players and celebs will represent their alma maters and battle it out for the Picklebowl 2023 trophy. Hosted by Heisman Trophy winner and former NFL player turned pickleball enthusiast, Danny Wuerffel.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: December 12, 2023 - Welcome to the second round of the semi-finals for season 2 of The Arizona Pickleball League! It's Tuesday Night Pickleball @ The Orchard, and the Gilbert Gladiators face-off against the Scottsdale Scorchers.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Pickleball Tour
programme.desc: Indiana’s Safdar faces Clemson’s Bozzetto in the 2024 DUPR National Championship Women’s Singles Final, battling for collegiate pickleball supremacy in a best-of-three format.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: At the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships, J.W. Johnson faces off against Brandon Lane in a hard-fought Men's Pro Singles Backdraw Semifinal. With powerful rallies, strategic drops, and relentless pressure, this match highlights Johnson's athleticism and Lane’s grit as they fight for a spot in the finals. Recorded live on Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The top-seeded Utah Tech Trailblazers take on a resilient USC squad in a high-stakes semifinal at the 2024 DUPR Nevada Super Regional in Henderson. This match features elite collegiate talent, including Avery Beck—the winningest player in collegiate pickleball history—and the powerful Cameron Bliss, as they look to defend their number-one ranking. Standing in their way is a "pesky" USC team led by Kylie Tran and Hannah Jiang, whose long-standing tennis chemistry translates into a formidable defensive pickleball strategy. With national bids already secured, both teams leave it all on the court for regional bragging rights and a spot in the championship final against Utah State.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The DUPR Collegiate Pickleball Virginia Super Regional semifinals deliver high-intensity action as the Clemson Tigers take on the UNC Tar Heels in a bid for the championship. Experience the elite skill of UNC's Sara Carpenter and the "Cinderella" play of Clemson's Fiorella Busetto in a women's doubles match where the lead never feels safe. With "March Madness" energy fueling every rally, the competition heats up as Kyle Compton brings a Dikembe Mutombo-style defensive presence to the court for the Tigers. Broadcast from Performance Pickleball RVA, this match captures the fierce rivalry and championship pedigree of two of the nation's top collegiate pickleball programs.

programme.title: The Wager
programme.desc: Jason Kennedy and Wes Burrows challenge Chandler Parsons and Jenna Bandy.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Naples JBB United face off against the Boca Raton Picklers in a women's match.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The "Superpower" FAU Owls look to cement their dominance as they face off against a formidable Utah Valley squad in National Semifinal Number Two. With elite pro-pedigree players on both sides and a spot in the National Championship on the line, witness the tactical precision and high-intensity hand battles that define collegiate pickleball's biggest stage. Experience every commanding lead and resilient comeback attempt as these two giants clash for the right to play for the title.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Rob Nunnery & Ryler Deheart faced off against Hunter Johnson & Yates Johnson in a quarterfinal match.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: It's the "Southern Derby" in the World Pickleball League (WPL) as Bengaluru takes on Chennai in the second tie of the day, live from the CCI Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai. The match features 48 players from six teams and 14 countries, with commentators detailing every crucial point.The tie begins with a thrilling Men's Singles match: Bengaluru's Blaskowitz (a Croatian talent) faces Chennai's Sobek (the Polish national champion). The commentators highlight the extreme patience and dinking skills demonstrated by both players, with Sobek's ability to keep the ball low being a key factor.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Kansas City Stingers face off against the Seattle United in a group NPL match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Watch the Gold Medal match of the Women’s Pro Split Age division at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships, where Parris Todd and Beth Bellamy team up to face Sheri Courter and Mari Humberg. Featuring cross-generational strategy, fast hands, and smart positioning, this match highlights the unique synergy of Split Age play. Recorded live from Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Boca Raton Picklers face off against the Oklahoma City Punishers in a men's match.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches its peak as the University of Florida and the University of Virginia face off in a high-stakes Semifinal and Final showdown. The intensity is palpable from the very first "time in," with athletes showcasing elite precision in specialized Skills challenges and explosive speed during the high-octane Racing segments. Between strategic volleys and creative Freestyle maneuvers, neither side gives an inch as the score oscillates through razor-thin margins, trading momentum with every "right back" play. This clash of titans proves why these two programs are the gold standard of collegiate pickleball, where every "point two" earned is a grueling step toward national history.
